regulations.name: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (EU) 2023/1114
regulations.notes: Art. 143(3): CASPs providing services under national law may continue until 1 Jul 2026 at the latest. Shorter national periods notified to ESMA (List of MiCA grandfathering periods, art. 143(3), https://www.esma.europa.eu/sites/default/files/2024-12/List_of_MiCA_grandfathering_periods_art._143_3.pdf): 6 months NL, FI, LV, HU, SI, PL; 9 months SE; 12 months DE, IE, LT, AT, SK, NO. Re-read on EUR-Lex and on the ESMA list on 2026-11-12.

regulations.name: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) - high-risk, standalone Annex III
regulations.notes: Deferred by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (OJ L, 24 Jul 2026): standalone high-risk (Annex III) from 2 Dec 2027; AI embedded in regulated products (Annex I) from 2 Aug 2028. Re-read on EUR-Lex on 2026-11-12.

regulations.name: Digital Operational Resilience Act (EU) 2022/2554
regulations.notes: Applies to financial entities and their ICT third-party providers. Art. 64: it shall apply from 17 January 2025. Re-read on EUR-Lex on 2026-11-12.

regulations.name: General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679
regulations.notes: Audit trails and provenance fields support accountability (Art. 5(2)). Art. 99(2): it shall apply from 25 May 2018. Re-read on EUR-Lex on 2026-11-12.

regulations.name: UAE VARA Rulebooks (Dubai, Law No. 4 of 2022)
regulations.notes: Dubai fuori DIFC. KYC/AML via goAML (STR near-real-time, 48h). Tech governance, custody segregation, market conduct. VA issuance guidance 04/2026 (ARVA). Mapping dai rulebook pubblici — NON certificazione VARA, confermare con legale.
